description: White canvas; stick figure with black headphones lower-left; large empty rectangular frame centre-right with a small object at its bottom edge. No text.
Grey rounded box appears at top with small bold 'Q.' at its left; appears in one sampled frame.
Grey box at top with only 'Q.'; headphone figure and empty frame unchanged.
Grey box shows second line typed left-to-right: '— My Brother, My Brother and Me (podcast)' in small bold grey text (f27 '— My B', f30 '— My Brother, My Brother and M', f32 complete).
Grey box with 'Q.' and attribution line '— My Brother, My Brother and Me (podcast)'; empty frame and headphone figure.
Question typed left-to-right after 'Q.': 'Would' then 'Would a toaster still work in' then 'Would a toaster still work in a freezer?'.
Grey box reading 'Q. Would a toaster still work in a freezer?' plus attribution; empty frame, headphone figure left.
In one frame the empty frame fills with a line-drawn cutaway fridge-freezer (two compartments, fan units, ice tray, window-like rectangle) and a ponytail stick figure seen from behind at right.
Frame contains freezer cutaway with fan units and ice tray, empty upper shelf, ponytail figure at right; grey Q box and headphone figure unchanged.
Toaster (no bread) with cord appears on the freezer shelf in one frame.
Empty toaster with cord on freezer shelf; same surroundings.
Bread slice appears standing up in the toaster slot.
Toaster with bread slice raised above slot.
Bread slice is pushed down into the toaster (lowered, barely visible).
Toaster with bread lowered; Q box still at top.

Blurred zoom/pan: Q box ghosts upward out of frame and headphone figure slides off left; view ends tighter on the freezer with new details visible: hanging lamp upper-right, wall outlet lower-left, power plug lower-right, milk carton in lower fridge.
Zoomed view: stacked freezer/fridge cutaway, toaster with bread on shelf, ponytail figure right, window rectangle, lamp upper-right, outlet lower-left; no Q box.
Whole scene shifts slightly (fridge edge/top move a few tens of px up-left); content otherwise identical. Exact motion UNRESOLVED.
Same scene with window rectangle still visible right of the freezer.
Window rectangle removed; fridge door handle at right edge and ponytail figure slightly shifted right. Change appears in one frame.
Toaster with bread and small red wavy heat lines above it; lamp, outlet, ponytail figure unchanged.
Red heat lines fade out while grey frost specks and drips fade in inside the freezer and on the toaster.
Freezer interior with grey frost specks and drips; toaster cold with no steam.
Frost gone; charred dark toast popped up high above the toaster with red heat lines on both sides.
Black toast raised above toaster, red wavy heat lines, no frost.
Toast gone; grey water-stain drips appear on upper interior and toaster; a grey wedge shape appears near the plug lower-right. Identity of wedge UNRESOLVED.
Grey drip stains on interior and toaster; grey wedge near plug beside ponytail figure.
Small black jagged spark marks appear near toaster cord and top-right; grey wedge tilts. Exact change UNRESOLVED.
Grey stains, black spark marks near toaster, grey wedge upright near plug.
Tiny spark marks appear at the plug area; change very small, UNRESOLVED.
Same scene with small spark marks at plug.
Background turns mid-grey; ponytail figure tilts with arms out and white zigzag electric lines around her, plug and lamp.
Grey background; tilted ponytail figure with white zigzag sparks; same fridge and lamp.
Two-line caps text appears at top: 'YOU MAY ALSO WANT TO RECONSIDER HAVING YOUR LIGHTING, TOASTER, AND REFRIGERATOR ALL ON ONE CIRCUIT'.
Grey scene with the circuit caption at top and electrified ponytail figure.

Hard cut to red title card: black dinosaur on satellite at top, white 'xkcd's what if?' and 'THE VIDEO SERIES'; sampled frames show no visible change during the card. Cut back to white scene occurs before f778 (onset UNRESOLVED between 32.0s and 32.4s).
White canvas; open freezer outline with door ajar, fan and ice tray, long counter line to the right; no toaster.
Toaster appears on the counter to the right of the freezer.
Open freezer at left and plain toaster on counter at right.
Label 'FOR COOLING' appears above freezer and frost specks appear inside it.
'FOR COOLING' above freezer with frost specks; toaster plain.
Label 'FOR HEATING' appears above toaster with short red heat lines.
Labels 'FOR COOLING' and 'FOR HEATING'; small red heat lines above toaster.
Red heat lines above toaster become taller and denser.
Toaster with dense red heat lines; both labels.
Toaster body shows black heating coils through its front.
Toaster with black coils and red heat lines; freezer with frost; both labels.
Coils turn orange-red and red glow appears around toaster; appears in one sampled frame.
Glowing red-orange coils with red halo; labels unchanged.
Label '600°C' written beneath the toaster over a few frames (f1035 first stroke, f1038 complete).
Glowing toaster with '600°C' below; freezer left; both labels above.
Hard cut to horizontal temperature axis: 'ABSOLUTE ZERO' at left, ticks 200K to 1000K with C and F values, arrow 'TOASTER COILS' near right end.
Axis ABSOLUTE ZERO, 200K -70C -100F through 1000K 730C 1340F; 'TOASTER COILS' arrow at right.
Label 'ROOM TEMPERATURE' with curved arrow appears near 300K.
Axis with 'ROOM TEMPERATURE' and 'TOASTER COILS' labels.
Label 'FRIDGE' with arrow appears left of 'ROOM TEMPERATURE'.
Axis with FRIDGE, ROOM TEMPERATURE and TOASTER COILS labels.
Label 'FREEZER' with arrow appears left of 'FRIDGE'.
Axis with FREEZER, FRIDGE, ROOM TEMPERATURE, TOASTER COILS.
Bracket drawn above the left half of the axis with text 'COLD (FOR TOASTER)' (f1270 short line at top-left, f1274 complete).
Axis with bracket 'COLD (FOR TOASTER)' spanning absolute zero to about 700K; all earlier labels.
Hard cut to white canvas: stick figure holding a toaster with long black wavy smoke lines rising to upper right; cord hanging.
Figure holding smoking toaster; black wavy lines, plug dangling.
Speech text 'IF I WANTED A BURNER I WOULD HAVE USED THE STOVE.' appears upper-left with leader line to the figure.
Figure with smoking toaster and speech text.
Hard cut to three-man group: stick figure hand on chin, bearded glasses figure, and glasses figure holding toast at right; tall fridge with open freezer door containing a toaster between them.
Three male stick figures around a fridge with open freezer containing toaster; no cord or outlet.
Power cord and wall outlet appear at right of fridge connecting to the freezer.
Fridge with toaster in open freezer; cord plugged into outlet at right.
Second outlet with short cord appears at lower-left of fridge.
Same scene with second outlet lower-left.
Toaster and open door removed; fridge now closed as a plain tall two-door box; outlets remain.
Closed fridge, three figures, outlets with cords.
Upper compartment turns blank and gains pink-red glow; grey drip stains grow downward over the lower door.
Upper compartment blank with red glow; grey drips on lower door.
'~1000W' written inside the glowing upper compartment (f1711 '~IC', f1713 '~1000W').
Glowing compartment reading '~1000W'; grey drips; three figures.
Hard cut to large black-line fridge cutaway: fan unit upper-right of interior, vertical coil panel at right edge, outlet with cord lower-right. No text.
Fridge cutaway with fan unit, coil panel and outlet; no labels.
Red marks drawn: arrow into the fan, red zigzag down the coil panel, then red arrow with 'E_OUT' to the right.
Red arrow into fan, red coil zigzag, 'E_OUT' arrow.
Text 'COP ≈ 3 (E_OUT/E_IN)' appears at upper right.
Cutaway with red arrows, 'E_OUT' and 'COP ≈ 3 (E_OUT/E_IN)'.
Black arrow 'E_IN' pointing left from outlet with small spark mark appears.
Labels COP ≈ 3, E_OUT red arrow, E_IN black arrow at outlet.
Red arrows multiply: three arrows into fan and E_OUT splits into three arrows.
Triple red arrows at fan and triple E_OUT arrows; E_IN black arrow.
Toaster appears inside the fridge interior and a second outlet with cord at far left runs to it; fan arrows now a burst.
Toaster inside fridge, left outlet with cord, red arrows, COP ≈ 3 and E_OUT/E_IN.
Red upward arrow appears above toaster.
Red arrow up from toaster; rest unchanged.
Small black arrow with spark mark appears left of toaster pointing right from outlet.
Black arrow from left outlet toward toaster; red up arrow.
Text 'COP ≈ 1' appears on the toaster front.
Toaster labelled 'COP ≈ 1'; arrows unchanged.
Over 11 frames red arrows radiate from toaster top (1 to about 4 to about 8 to about 12 arrows) while black arrows at the left grow in count from 1 to about 10.
Toaster 'COP ≈ 1' with fan of red arrows above and column of black arrows at left; E_IN and E_OUT at right.
Label '~100W' appears next to E_IN near the right outlet.
'~100W' by E_IN; all earlier marks.
'~1000W' written next to left outlet (f2381 '~', f2384 '~100', f2387 '~1000W').
'~1000W' at left outlet and '~100W' at right E_IN.
Toaster fills with red glow, deepening over about 12 frames to solid red with halo.
Red glowing toaster 'COP ≈ 1' in fridge with arrows and wattage labels.

Hard cut to ice cream factory freezer room: big fan and vent above, stacked tubs left, gauge; chef-hat figure holding bread over a toaster on a stool; mustached figure speaking 'THAT'S NOT HOW YOU MAKE AN ICE CREAM SANDWICH'; ponytail figure beside a machine.
Freezer room with chef figure and plain toaster on stool; speech text; mustached figure; ponytail figure at machine.
Toaster fades from plain to red glow and label '600°C' fades in on it.
Red glowing toaster labelled '600°C'; chef figure; speech text.
Label '-18°C' appears above the toaster.
Scene with '-18°C' and red '600°C' toaster; speech text unchanged; long hold.
Hard cut to white outdoor scene: 'WINNIPEG, CANADA' upper-left, hatted figure holding toast, house eave with icicles upper-left, black spruce silhouettes at right.
White background Winnipeg scene with hatted figure holding toast and black spruce trees.

Grey night Winnipeg scene with 'WINNIPEG, CANADA (-20°C)', stars, figure holding toast.

Plain toaster on stool with cord to ground power strip.

Figure leaning over red glowing toaster.

Arms-raised figure and toast above glowing toaster.

Figure left holding toast, red toaster on stool, dark trees.

Crouched figure next to red toaster; 'AWOO...' text; long hold.

Podcast table with three seated men, boom mic, hatted figure holding toast at left.
